statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n^2+1) = if (n^2+1).Prime then Real.log (n^2+1) else 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 方法与自然推广 · 二次 Mangoldt 权的精确支撑
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Identify the exact support of the quadratic Mangoldt weight

brief.zh: P03 的差为 4 的非零倍数，故 $\Im(a+i)^j$ 不能等于 $1$ 或 $-1$。合并 P01–P03 和已有偶指数引理，对每个 $n\ge1$ 证明 $\Lambda(n^2+1)=\mathbf1_{n^2+1\ {\rm prime}}\log(n^2+1)$。特别地，原题任一非空窗口有正质量即有真素数值。交 `levent-prime-values-weight-split`、`lpf-endpoint`。
brief.en: Exclude even exponents by consecutive squares and odd exponents by the Gaussian binomial calculation.
